softSelectBtn.tip: Skin a first pass with soft selection.
softSelectBtn.what: Select joints: each one gets the vertices closest to it with a soft falloff (falloff slider and curve).
steps: Set Falloff and the curve side.
examples: Load the mesh, select the spine joints, click it for a smooth first pass.
Soft first pass on a belly.
softSelectBtn.details: SkinUtils.soft_select_skin_pass(mesh, joint_dict=selected joints, expand, falloff, curve, mirror): for each joint takes the closest vertex, grows it by Expand rings and / or fades it with the falloff curve, and writes the weights. Mirror does the other side too. Here expand is 0.

code.connect: lambda: ms.soft_select_skin_pass( mirror=self.ui.mirrorBox.isChecked(), expand=0, curve=curve_values[self.sidesGrp.checkedButton().text()], falloff=float('.'+self.ui.falloffValueLabel.text()), mesh=self.ui.meshNameLoadField.text(), joint_dict=cmds.ls(sl=True))

growSelectBtn.tip: Skin a first pass by growing the selection.
growSelectBtn.what: Select joints: each one gets the closest vertices grown by the Expand amount, hard edged.
examples: Use it for armor plates that should not bend.
Hard first pass on plates of armor.
growSelectBtn.details: SkinUtils.soft_select_skin_pass(mesh, joint_dict=selected joints, expand, falloff, curve, mirror): for each joint takes the closest vertex, grows it by Expand rings and / or fades it with the falloff curve, and writes the weights. Mirror does the other side too. Here falloff is 0 (hard edges).

code.connect: lambda: ms.soft_select_skin_pass( mirror=self.ui.mirrorBox.isChecked(), expand=int(self.ui.expandValueLabel.text()), falloff=0, mesh=self.ui.meshNameLoadField.text(), joint_dict=cmds.ls(sl=True))

combinedBtn.tip: Skin a first pass, grow plus soft falloff.
combinedBtn.what: Combines Grow and SoftSelect: grows the closest vertices, then fades them with the falloff.
steps: Set Expand, Falloff and the curve.
examples: The usual first pass for a body: select all joints, click it.
First pass on a whole creature body.
combinedBtn.details: SkinUtils.soft_select_skin_pass(mesh, joint_dict=selected joints, expand, falloff, curve, mirror): for each joint takes the closest vertex, grows it by Expand rings and / or fades it with the falloff curve, and writes the weights. Mirror does the other side too.

dualquatnonriging_btn.tip: Set every skin to Dual Quaternion non rigid.
dualquatnonriging_btn.what: Switches all skinClusters to Dual Quaternion with non rigid support, to keep volume on twists.
examples: Click it when wrists lose volume on a twist.
Keep the forearm volume on twist.
dualquatnonriging_btn.details: skinningMethod 1 (Dual Quaternion) and dqsSupportNonRigid 1 on every skinCluster in the scene.

deltascale_btn.tip: Make the delta mushes follow the global scale.
deltascale_btn.what: Connects the Global ctrl rig scale to every delta mush, so the smoothing scales with the rig.
examples: Click it when the character looks blurry once scaled down.
Fix deltaMush blur on a small scaled rig.
deltascale_btn.details: Connects Global_Ctrl.rigScale to scaleX / Y / Z of every deltaMush. Errors if one is already connected.

offskin_btn.tip: Back to normal skinning (Move Joints mode off).
offskin_btn.what: Turns off Move Joints mode on every skinCluster: moving joints deforms the meshes again.
examples: Click it after moving joints with Turn On Skins.
Go back to normal skinning after moving joints.

on_skins.tip: Move joints without moving the meshes.
on_skins.what: Turns on Move Joints mode on every skinCluster: you can move or reorient joints and the skinned meshes stay put.
examples: Slide the elbow joint to a better spot without breaking the skin, then Turn Off Skins.
Fix a joint pivot after skinning without reskinning.
on_skins.details: skinCluster -e -moveJointsMode true on every skinCluster. Remember to turn it off: in this mode nothing deforms.

meshNameLoadBtn.what: Puts the selected mesh in the mesh field used by the first pass buttons.
examples: Select the body and click <<<.
Load the head mesh before a face first pass.
meshNameLoadBtn.details: First selected object name into the mesh field.

select_bind_jnts.tip: Select the bind joints of the mesh.
select_bind_jnts.what: Selects the joints the mesh in the field should be skinned to.
examples: Click it, then shift select the mesh and bind.
Select joints to bind a duplicate of the mesh.
select_bind_jnts.details: Selects the skinCluster influences of the mesh (field or selection); with the null check on, Null_Local_Bnd is left out.

save_skin_button.tip: Save the skins of the scene.
save_skin_button.what: Saves the current skin weights to the pipeline skin folder.
examples: Save before a rebuild or a model update.
Save before a model update.
save_skin_button.details: Studio pipeline (rigSystem / rstar): saves every skinCluster with the IO skin format into the asset SID folder.

load_button.tip: List the assets of this type.
load_button.what: Fills the asset list with the assets of the type picked above.
examples: Pick "Characters" and click Load.
List props to find the one you need.
load_button.details: star Project.findby_name(show): fills the type and asset lists.

version_load_button.tip: List the versions of the asset.
version_load_button.what: Fills the version list with the published versions of the asset.
examples: Pick the asset, click it, then pick the version with good skin.
List versions to load the skin from last week.
version_load_button.details: Lists the work versions of the asset and the skin files found in them.

load_skin_button.what: Loads the skin file picked in the list onto the geo picked in the list.
examples: Load the last approved skin on the new model.
Load skin on a new model version.
load_skin_button.details: rigSystem skin.load(json): on the geo picked, or Everything.

ref_copy_btn.tip: Reference a version and copy its skin.
ref_copy_btn.what: References the chosen version and copies the skin of each geo by closest point.
examples: The model changed a little: copy the old skin onto it.
Copy skin after the modeler moved some verts.
ref_copy_btn.details: References the version with namespace SkinningRef, copySkinWeights closest point per geo, then removes the reference.

ref_copy_uv_btn.tip: Reference a version and copy its skin by UVs.
ref_copy_uv_btn.what: Same as Ref-Copy but matches by UVs, for models that changed shape but kept UVs.
examples: The model was resculpted: copy the skin by UVs.
Copy skin after a big resculpt with the same UVs.
ref_copy_uv_btn.details: Same as Ref-Copy with -uvSpace: matches by UVs instead of position.

copy_skin_to_nurb.tip: Copy the skin from a mesh to a NURBS surface.
copy_skin_to_nurb.what: Select the mesh, then the NURBS: the NURBS gets the same weights.
examples: Make a ribbon follow the skin of the body.
Skin a ribbon to follow a skirt.
copy_skin_to_nurb.details: Skins the NURBS to the mesh joints and copies the weight of the closest mesh point to each CV ((spansU+degreeU) x (spansV+degreeV) CVs).

click_copy_button.tip: Copy the skin from first to last selected.
click_copy_button.what: Skins the last selected geo to the same joints as the first one and copies the weights.
examples: Select the body, then the shirt, click it: the shirt deforms like the body.
Copy body skin to a jacket.
click_copy_button.details: skinCluster the last selected to the influences of the first (detaching an old skin if needed), then copySkinWeights closest point, closest joint.
